metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for Upland Software teams.

plugins.name: burnrate-claude
plugins.description: Real-time AWS Bedrock cost display — session cost and month-to-date in the Claude Code statusline.

plugins.name: skillforge
plugins.description: Enterprise AI skill library — install, upload, and manage team skills from Claude Code.

plugins.name: memory-management-skills
plugins.description: Memory & knowledge-base skills — set up an LLM-maintained Obsidian knowledge base (karpathy-obsidian-memory-setup): raw/ inbox, LLM-compiled wiki/, filed-back answers. Refresh with /plugin marketplace update.

plugins.name: pv-legacy-skills
plugins.description: Panviva Core (legacy SupportPoint) skills — always-on production-incident investigation that grounds every claim in New Relic telemetry across the C# web tier, the SPIL modules, and the C++ mentord appserver, and validates or corrects an RCA someone else wrote (panviva-prod-investigation, by Tristan, ships with its nrql.sh helper). Refresh with /plugin marketplace update.

plugins.name: sangt-daily-mandatory-skills
plugins.description: SangT's daily-driver skills — the set worth installing on every machine: a morning briefing (start-my-day), compact multi-model structured planning for goal-driven execution (plan-for-goal with Gemini 3.8, GPT-5.6, GPT-6 Astra, Kimi 3), plus the cross-session workflow (project-setup, session-start, session-handoff, session-calibrate). Refresh with /plugin marketplace update.

plugins.name: upld-git-skills
plugins.description: Upland git & release workflow skills — commit messages, PR self-review checklists, and changelog entries. Install this bundle; new git skills arrive via /plugin marketplace update (no reinstall).

plugins.name: upld-modernisation-skills
plugins.description: Panviva modernisation skills — implementation-readiness audits of a PANV epic or story with every claim source-cited (pv-modernisation-readiness-audit), plus always-on C# /// XML documentation enforcement with its checker script and pre-commit hook (panviva-xml-docs, and the Copilot dialect). Refresh with /plugin marketplace update.
